sample.description: Observers coding undergraduate STEM classes in the development study: 16 K-12 teachers observing 23 classes at one university, and 7 STEM faculty observing 8 classes at a second university after 1.5 hours of training.

source.citation: Smith, M. K., Jones, F. H. M., Gilbert, S. L., & Wieman, C. E. (2013). The Classroom Observation Protocol for Undergraduate STEM (COPUS): A new instrument to characterize university STEM classroom practices. CBE-Life Sciences Education, 12(4), 618-627.
